title: Satu Dua Cha-cha-cha
subject: a 58-year-old man with two left feet who secretly pays for ten ballroom lessons so he can dance one proper cha-cha with his wife on their thirtieth anniversary
caption: Indonesian orkes dansa cha-cha, 1960s dance-hall style. Nylon-string guitar playing a clipped cha-cha rhythm, congas and claves on the cha-cha-cha accent, upright bass walking on the beat, muted trumpet answering the vocal. Vintage dance-hall room sound, warm tape. Male vocal, warm baritone, gentle and earnest, sung clearly in Indonesian. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 112 BPM, A minor. Tender, bouncy mood. No electronic beats, no autotune, no synth pads, no rap, no rock drum kit, no dangdut tabla.
lyrics:
[Intro - claves and nylon guitar]

[Verse 1]
Aku Darto, lima puluh delapan tahun
Kakiku kaku, kata istriku dulu
Diam-diam daftar kursus sepuluh kali
Tiap Selasa pamit beli paku

[Pre-Chorus]
Guru dansa menghitung keras-keras
Aku menghitung dalam hati

[Chorus]
Satu, dua, cha-cha-cha
Lastri, tunggu aku di lantai
Satu, dua, cha-cha-cha
Kali ini kakiku tahu jalan

[Verse 2]
Ketujuh kali, kuinjak sepatu guru
Kedelapan kali, sepatuku sendiri
Pulang latihan di dapur
Lastri tanya, kok pakunya nggak ada

[Chorus]
Satu, dua, cha-cha-cha
Lastri, tunggu aku di lantai
Satu, dua, cha-cha-cha
Tiga puluh tahun, baru sekarang

[Verse 3]
Malam ini musik main di aula
Kuulurkan tangan, dia tertawa kecil
Katanya, tiap Selasa dia sudah tahu
Dan aku pura-pura percaya soal paku

[Chorus]
Satu, dua, cha-cha-cha
Lastri, ikut aku di lantai
Satu, dua, cha-cha-cha
Kakiku salah, tanganmu benar

[Outro - congas and trumpet]
